Summary and Conclusions
This section has provided an analysis of the potential social and economic impacts expected in association with expansion of the coal mining activities of Westmoreland Resources. Primary attention has been given to the demographic and economic implications of different levels of mining activity, both on the Westmoreland tracts and in the surrounding impact area. The following paragraphs represent an attempt to summarize the main conclusions of the socio-economic analysis.
